data.name: Aiyaz
data.gender_notes: Aiyaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aiyaz means ‘the mighty, the strong one’. It is a name rooted in courage and valor, reminiscent of early Muslims who fought for their faith. In the Islamic context, it is a name of strength and bravery. The name Aiyaz carries the meaning “Strong, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aiyaz usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the spiritual strength and courage required to overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Aiyaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aiyaz total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عاياز
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عاياز مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عبد' أو 'خادم'. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى العبد أو الخادم المخلص. يعود أصول الاسم إلى العصور الوسطى في العالم الإسلامي، وكان يستخدم كاسم للمولودين الجدد.

in_urdu.name: عایاز
in_urdu.meaning: عایاز مطلب ہے خادم یا عبد
in_urdu.long_meaning: عایاز ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خادم یا عبد۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔ اس کا استعمال اسلامی تقویم کے ابتدائی دور سے ہوتا آیا ہے اور آج بھی اس کا استعمال جاری ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आइयाज़
in_hindi.meaning: आइयाज़ का अर्थ है सेवक या दास
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइयाज़ एक लोकप्रिय मुस्लिम नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सेवक या दास। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रचलित है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: عاياز
in_pashto.meaning: عاياز د خادم يا عبد معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاياز نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه نه دی، خو د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د خادم يا عبد په معنی دی. په افغانستان کې، دا نوم د مسلمانانو تر منځ ډیر مشهور دی.

historical_references.context: Ibn Kathir mentions Aiyaz ibn Ghanam as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a participant in many battles, including the Battle of Uhud (6th AH / 628 AD). He was also a member of the Prophet's military expedition to Tabuk (8th AH / 630 AD).

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz as-Sahabah (The Distinction Between the Companions) by Ibn Hajar Al-'Asqalani The name Aiyaz carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Hajar Al-'Asqalani provides a detailed biography of Aiyaz ibn Ghanam, mentioning his lineage, his early life in Medina, his role in various military campaigns, and his relationship with other Companions of the Prophet (pbuh). He also records Aiyaz's participation in the Battle of Hunayn (8th AH / 630 AD).
